description: Focused deep search for works in which an adult female character is hypnotized (by a man, woman, device, app, stage hypnotist, villain, or other agent), across films, TV episodes, anime/OVA, web series, vertical microdramas, YouTube/shorts, games/VNs, manga/comics/webtoons, novels, and AI-generated works. 25 Nov 2026 PT. records.title: Hypnotism Confidential / Girl Trap
records.meta: United States exploitation drama · also distributed as Girl Trap · produced by Peter Anthony De Cenzie for Pad Productions · approved for New York exhibition in 1957 · shot in and around San Francisco
records.character: Sylvia (a waitress); Zee Zee Martine (a dancer); Tony Anthonelli's aunt; Flame Kelly
records.summary: Official AFI catalog copy follows a masked hypnotist-narrator who hypnotizes dancer Zee Zee Martine, then a story in which Tony Anthonelli uses a fountain-pen trigger to hypnotize people around him, including his aunt and waitress Sylvia. After Sylvia is later found to be pregnant with no memory of one night, a psychiatrist hypnotizes her again to recover what happened, and a warrant is issued for Anthonelli.
records.evidence: The official AFI Catalog record for Hypnotism Confidential (1957, also distributed as Girl Trap) states that a masked hypnotist introduces dancer Zee Zee Martine and proceeds to hypnotize her, and that in the story Tony Anthonelli hypnotizes his aunt so she will write him a check and forget, then uses a fountain-pen trigger to hypnotize waitress Sylvia. The same official synopsis states that the district attorney's office investigates how Sylvia has mysteriously become pregnant; psychiatrist Dr. Vincent reports a complete loss of memory and, by re-hypnotizing Sylvia, unlocks her memory of being attacked by Anthonelli.

records.title: Psychothérapie en URSS / Psychotherapy in the USSR
records.meta: Soviet 16 mm colour sound film · about 13 minutes (part 1) · French-language print held by Cinemantik as 040J-16-PSY70
records.character: Unnamed adult female hospital patient in labour; other adult female patients shown under hypnosis
records.summary: A film-archive listing describes a 1970 Soviet film on psychotherapy in which a doctor hypnotizes a frightened hospital patient, who is then taken to a delivery room, has contractions without pain, gives birth calmly while following the nurses' instructions, and is awakened after the birth. Other sequences show adult women hypnotized in a lecture hall and in a consulting room.
records.evidence: The Cinemantik archive page for Psychothérapie en URSS / Psychotherapy in the USSR (1970, ref. 040J-16-PSY70, about 13 minutes) describes a Soviet film about psychotherapy used to treat sick women and to help them give birth without pain. Its shot list states that a patient who is afraid in a hospital bed is hypnotized by a doctor, taken to the delivery room, has contractions without pain, gives birth calmly, follows the nurses' instructions, and wakes after delivery, after which the doctor explains his method. Earlier shots describe other adult female patients being hypnotized in an auditorium and in a consulting room.
